entities.name: Isabel Alçada
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria Isabel Girão de Melo Veiga Vilar, better known by her pen name, Isabel Alçada, is a Portuguese teacher, writer, and politician. As a writer, she is mainly dedicated to children's literature, being primarily known for writing the Uma aventura series of books with her writing partner Ana Maria Magalhães.
